meta.name: ChefFlow component registry
meta.rule: Search this registry before writing any interface element. Reuse the canonical entry. If it almost fits, add a documented variant to the canonical component. Only build something new when no entry covers the need, and register it in the same change.

statusMeaning.canonical-gap: Canonical, but with a named gap that must be closed before heavy new use.
statusMeaning.deprecated: Superseded. Do not use in new code.
statusMeaning.missing: No implementation exists. Building one is a legitimate addition; register it here.
statusMeaning.duplicate: Overlaps a canonical entry and should be folded into it.

meta.tokenPolicy: A component consumes semantic tokens (var(--...), brand-*, stone-*, surface-*, status-*). A component never contains a raw hex, rgb() literal or an inline style colour.
meta.statePolicy: Every interactive component defines default, hover, focus-visible, active and disabled. Anything that can be async also defines loading and error.
meta.meaningPolicy: Status meaning is global, silhouette is local. success/warning/danger/info/neutral mean the same thing whether they appear as a dot, chip, row accent, icon or text.
meta.importPolicy: Icons come from '@/components/ui/icons'. Class merging uses cn() from '@/lib/utils'. Note that cn is clsx only, with no tailwind-merge, so a caller className does NOT override a conflicting base class; pass the variant prop instead of fighting it with className.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Every user-triggered action. Renders a <button>, or an <a> when href is given.

variants.secondary: surface-2 ground, stone border, surface-3 hover

components.responsive: Every size clears the 44px touch minimum. Full-width on mobile is the caller's className (w-full sm:w-auto).
a11y: White on brand-700 measures 4.74:1, passing WCAG AA.
focus-visible ring offset now uses --ring-offset-surface rather than a pinned dark colour.
An href Button that is disabled or loading drops its href, leaves the tab order and sets aria-disabled.
components.contentLimits: One to three words. Never a sentence. Maximum one primary Button per screen.
components.incorrect: <button className="bg-brand-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-2"> - a hand-built button. 3,395 raw <button> elements exist across 1,178 files; every styled one is a violation.
changed2026_09_09: href variant no longer ignores disabled/loading

components.name: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter
components.purpose: The grouping container. The most-used component in the codebase.
components.sizes: No size prop. Padding is fixed at px-6 py-4 on header, content and footer.
components.responsive: Fluid. Stack cards in a grid with gap-card-grid (1.25rem).
a11y: An interactive Card with an onClick now takes role=button, tabIndex 0, Enter/Space activation and a visible focus ring.
Prefer wrapping a real <a> or <Button> inside the card when the whole card is a link, so the browser gives you the semantics for free.
components.contentLimits: Use a card to group 3 to 8 related things. Never one card per single toggle. Never cards for a list of 10+ similar items; use rows.
components.incorrect: A hand-written div with rounded-xl border border-stone-700/40. 385 files do this.
components.knownGap: Borders are hardcoded stone-* rather than --border-* tokens.
changed2026_09_09: interactive cards became keyboard operable and focusable

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: A small labelled status or category chip.
components.sizes: None. Every badge is px-3 py-1 text-xs.
a11y: Every status pair measures above 7:1. Never rely on the colour alone; the label carries the meaning.
components.knownGap: Variant naming drifts from the token role names: error maps to danger, default maps to neutral.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.purpose: Maps 25 domain statuses (draft, proposed, accepted, paid, confirmed, in_progress, completed, cancelled, ...) onto a tier, then to a chip.
components.decision: Zero importers. Its STATUS_MAP is genuinely useful; its chip is a second Badge. Fold the map into Badge as a `status` prop and delete the chip. Until then, do not import it.

components.name: SaveStateBadge
components.purpose: Draft save state: SAVING, SAVED, OFFLINE_QUEUED, ERROR with retry.
a11y: role=status aria-live=polite is already correct.
components.knownGap: A fourth badge implementation that does not reuse STATUS_BADGE_CONTRAST_CLASSES.

components.name: StatusDot
components.purpose: The smallest silhouette of a status: a coloured dot with an optional ping.
a11y: A dot alone is colour-only meaning. Always pair it with adjacent text or an aria-label.
components.note: Currently unused, but it is the right primitive for the dot silhouette of a status. Use it rather than a hand-rolled span.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line text entry with label, helper text and error.
a11y: Wires aria-invalid, aria-describedby and role=alert on the error text.
Renders at max(16px, 0.9375rem) so iOS does not auto-zoom. Never override that down.
components.knownGap: Uses bg-stone-900 rather than a --surface-* token, so a form inside a Card sits on a different surface scale than the card. Correcting it is a visual change across 233 files and is queued as MIGRATION.md M-05, not done blind.
components.incorrect: <input className="rounded-lg border border-stone-600 bg-stone-800 px-3 py-2" />

components.name: Textarea
components.note: Character counter turns amber above 90% and red at the limit, which matches the status roles.

components.name: Select (native) and SelectRoot/Trigger/Value/Content/Item (compound)
components.knownGap: The compound variant has no keyboard navigation, no Escape, no outside-click close and no role=listbox. Prefer the native Select until that is fixed. Tracked as MIGRATION.md M-06.
changed2026_09_09: SelectContent no longer hardcodes rgba(28,25,23,0.9); it uses --glass-heavy-bg, --border-subtle and --elevation-overlay
z-float now resolves to a real layer (70)

components.name: RadioGroup
components.note: Fully brand-tokenised. Use it as the model for new form controls.

components.name: Switch
a11y: role=switch with aria-checked and aria-disabled.
changed2026_09_09: disabled is now applied to the interactive <button>. Before this it landed only on the hidden input, so a disabled Switch looked enabled and still toggled.

components.name: AddressAutocomplete / LocationAutocomplete / StoreAutocomplete
components.note: Google Maps backed. Any new place-entry field uses one of these, never a raw text input.

components.name: RichTextEditor / RichNoteEditor / RichTextRenderer
components.note: TipTap. Its styles live in components/ui/rich-text-editor-styles.css, the only CSS file outside globals.css.

components.name: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell
components.contentLimits: 7 columns by default; anything beyond goes behind a column chooser.
components.knownGap: No selected, focused, sorted, disabled or loading row state. Every cell is whitespace-nowrap. 100% hardcoded stone-*.
components.responsive: Wrap in ResponsiveTable, or give the mobile breakpoint a card list. A table that only scrolls sideways on a phone is a defect.

components.name: ResponsiveTable
components.purpose: Renders a table above the breakpoint and a stacked card list below it.
components.note: Unused today. This is the answer to the mobile-table problem; reach for it before inventing another one.

components.name: StatCard
components.knownGap: Reimplements Card variant=default interactive with its own hardcoded stone classes. Should be built on Card.
components.contentLimits: Two hero metrics per dashboard, five supporting metrics. If everything is a hero, nothing is.

components.name: AnimatedCounter
a11y: Count-up motion must be suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion; the global block now handles it.

components.name: Recharts wrappers
components.knownGap: 120 raw hex values. Chart series colours must come from the token palette; this is the single worst offender file for raw colour.

components.name: Alert
a11y: error and warning take role=alert with aria-live=assertive; info and success take role=status with aria-live=polite. Callers can override role for static page furniture.
changed2026_09_09: Added the announcement roles. Before this, none of the ~135 call sites were announced by a screen reader.
components.knownGap: Not dismissible. Four hand-inlined SVGs instead of components/ui/icons.

components.name: toast (sonner) and showUndoToast
components.purpose: Transient confirmation. showUndoToast adds a deferred-execute-with-undo pattern.
components.contentLimits: Confirmation auto-dismisses at 3s, warning at 5s, error never. Never more than 2 toasts at once.
components.note: Toast visual styling lives in the sonner Toaster config, not here.

components.name: ErrorState, InlineError, DataGuard
a11y: role=alert
components.purpose: The failure state of a data region. Never show $0.00 or an empty list when a load actually failed.

components.name: EmptyState

variants.remy: pondering | idle | sleeping | aha | straight-face | false

components.contentLimits: One sentence of description, at most two actions.
changed2026_09_09: Replaced the raw rgba(232,143,71,0.15) drop shadow with rgb(var(--brand-500)/0.15).

components.name: Skeleton, SkeletonCard, SkeletonRow, SkeletonTable, SkeletonKPITile
components.knownGap: Two independent skeleton systems exist: the .skeleton CSS class (6 importers) and .loading-bone* via page-skeleton (155 importers). page-skeleton is the de-facto standard.

components.name: ListPageSkeleton, DetailPageSkeleton, FormPageSkeleton, GridPageSkeleton
components.purpose: The loading.tsx body for a route. Match the skeleton to the page shape so nothing shifts when data lands.
a11y: Skeletons are aria-hidden; the surrounding region carries role=status.

components.name: LoadingSpinner, LoadingBone, CenteredLoadingState
a11y: CenteredLoadingState carries role=status aria-live=polite.
Spinners are exempt from the reduced-motion suppression because they are the only feedback that work is happening.
components.contentLimits: No indicator below 1s. Skeleton or spinner 1-2s. Progress 2-10s. Background task plus notification beyond 10s.

components.name: DeterminateProgress, ProgressPill, ProgressRing, StepProgress, RouteProgress
components.knownGap: Five separate progress primitives with no shared base and inconsistent colour derivation.

components.name: AccessibleDialog
components.purpose: The modal primitive. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock, focus restore, full ARIA.
components.sizes: widthClassName is the size prop: max-w-sm | max-w-md | max-w-lg | max-w-2xl.
a11y: role=dialog aria-modal aria-labelledby aria-describedby. The best-implemented primitive in the repo.
changed2026_09_09: Panel colour moved from the literal rgba(28,25,23,0.85) to --glass-heavy-bg so it follows the theme.
z-dialog now resolves to layer 60 instead of z-index auto.

components.name: ConfirmModal
a11y: Destructive confirm is never adjacent to cancel without at least 16px of separation.

components.name: DropdownMenu and parts
components.purpose: The only Radix-backed primitive. Keyboard navigation, Escape and focus trap come free.
components.note: Only 4 files import it while 189 hand-roll a dropdown. Use this one.
changed2026_09_09: z-50 became z-float (70) so a menu opened inside a dialog renders above it.

components.name: GlobalTooltipProvider
components.purpose: A single delegated tooltip engine. Add data-tooltip to any element; do not mount a tooltip component.
a11y: Tooltips appear on focus as well as hover. A tooltip is never the only place information lives.

components.name: Sheet / Drawer
components.purpose: An edge-anchored panel for mobile actions and filters.
components.note: Feature-local drawers exist (components/dinner-circles/action-drawer.tsx, components/ai/remy-drawer.tsx) but there is no primitive. Build one on AccessibleDialog's focus-management core rather than from scratch.

components.name: Popover
components.note: Use DropdownMenu where a menu fits. A true popover primitive is an open gap.

components.name: TabNav and TabNav.Panel
components.purpose: The app's only tabs primitive. Roving tabIndex, Arrow/Home/End keys, scroll-into-view, lazy and keepMounted panels.
components.contentLimits: 6 tabs per page; overflow into a dropdown.
a11y: Full role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected. The best-engineered component in the repo.
components.knownGap: The active tab is hardcoded amber-500 rather than brand-*. It is the single most visible token violation in the shared layer.

components.name: Pagination
components.note: Zero implementations repo-wide. Lists page by server query today. Build one primitive before the second list needs it.

components.name: Accordion / Disclosure
components.knownGap: Only a feature-local FAQ accordion exists. Promote it to components/ui with aria-expanded, aria-controls and height motion honouring reduced motion.

components.name: StepWizard
components.purpose: Multi-step flow with a step indicator. Pair with StepProgress.

components.name: Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback
components.purpose: Person or entity image with an initials fallback. Cloudinary-optimised.
components.sizes: Size comes from the caller className. Use the avatar scale: 24 / 32 / 40 / 56 / 80.
components.note: Any new avatar surface uses this, never a raw with a remote URL.

components.name: ImageWithFallback
components.rule: Documented in docs/specs/visual-representation-strategy.md as the standard image display. Do not create a new image component.

components.name: Photo galleries
components.knownGap: Ten separate gallery implementations across photos, portfolio, profile, events, client-portal, hub, sharing, recipes and clients. One Gallery primitive with a per-domain adapter is the consolidation target.

components.name: Carousel
components.note: No carousel library and no primitive. The discovery rail is a scroll-snap row, which is the preferred pattern: it degrades to a plain scrollable list and needs no JavaScript.

components.name: TrackedVideo
components.knownGap: The one demo video has no poster frame, no WebM fallback and no captions track. Captions are an accessibility requirement, not a nicety.

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: h1 plus subtitle plus actions. Unused today but it is the right primitive; use it instead of hand-writing a heading block.

components.name: SectionDivider
components.note: Delegates to the .section-label CSS class, which is fully tokenised.

components.name: ResponsivePage
components.note: Handles safe-area insets. Use it for any new full-page surface.

components.name: ErrorBoundary, WidgetErrorBoundary
components.rule: Every independently-loading dashboard section is wrapped in WidgetErrorBoundary so one failure does not blank the page.

components.name: FadeIn, FadeInStagger
a11y: Suppressed by the global reduced-motion block, which forces the final state rather than leaving content at opacity 0.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.rule: Pinned by tests/unit/theme-and-color-guards.test.ts to appear only in components/navigation/public-header.tsx.

components.name: ColorPaletteProvider, PaletteScript, usePalette
components.purpose: Swaps the --brand-* ramp at runtime across 8 named palettes. PaletteScript runs inline in <head> to avoid a flash.
components.rule: Because the brand ramp is swappable, a component that hardcodes #e88f47 breaks every non-default palette. That is the concrete reason the Prism rule exists.

components.name: Icon re-exports
components.purpose: 347 Phosphor icons re-exported under their Lucide-equivalent names.
components.rule: Import from '@/components/ui/icons'. 53 files still import lucide-react directly; both libraries currently ship.

components.name: Branded illustrations
components.knownGap: 91 raw hex values inline. Illustration colours should read from the brand ramp so they follow the active palette.

duplicateCounts.note: Canonical exports are clean: exactly one Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Table, Switch, Avatar, Alert, Skeleton, EmptyState. The duplication is ad-hoc re-implementation, not competing exports.
